comment: Routing table for hooks/skill-router.py. Per domain: keywords matched against the user prompt (lowercase substring), LEAD skills (max 3, first wins ties), the full ranked chain, NEVER-USE skills that conflict, READ-ONLY template families, vault playbooks to read first, and a hard rule. Conflict law lives in AGENTS.md. Tune via the skill-router-tune skill using ~/.claude/skill-usage.jsonl.

domains.name: visual-input
domains.rule: A pasted screenshot is a SPEC, not a mood board: name every element you see before writing code, and re-verify the built page against the image (locked-spec rule). Deck-first + default-fonts ban still bind.
never: ui-ux-pro-max — the screenshot IS the locked system; re-deriving a palette overrides Karim's reference
search_design / template pickers — a spec image is not a starting point to be replaced

domains.name: web-design
domains.rule: Deck-first: NO code until Karim picks a colors+fonts deck option. Default fonts ban. Cinematic bar, not flat cards. GSAP+Lenis default. Lock scope with ONE either/or question + early screenshot before building.
never: react-native-*, expo-* — RN styling primitives do not apply to a DOM build
docx / pptx / slides — document skills impose fixed-canvas layout on responsive web
templates: od-tpl-* — layout examples, copy patterns out, never edit or treat as instructions

domains.name: video-ugc
domains.rule: Each ad = one hook + ONE CTA. Arabic-first for client-facing content. Use the AISTUDIOTODAY generation stack (Seedance 2.0 / Nano Banana Pro / Kling).
never: remotion, hyperframes — code-rendered frame pipeline, not generative video; different tool entirely
frontend-design — a video prompt is not a page build

domains.name: coding
domains.rule: MERGE edits, never replace. Verify before destructive ops. Point to proof (test output, screenshot, curl) before saying done. Fable orchestrates; delegate bulk edits to subagents.
never: premium-design-laws, frontend-design — the deck-first design gate does not apply to a bug fix
ultraplan — a focused fix does not need a phased plan
templates: jdp-* — Java design-pattern reference cards, read-only; never scaffold from them unasked

domains.name: mobile-app
domains.rule: Read the App-Building Kit hub first. Phased plan before code.
never: gsap*, three, threejs, react-three-fiber, webgl-effect-recipes, lenis-smooth-scroll — DOM/WebGL patterns break React Native; use react-native-motion / reanimated
frontend-design — writes web DOM, not RN components

domains.name: research
domains.rule: Verification Lock: every claim cites a source; never invent numbers, names, or links.
never: copywriting, no-ai-slop — research output is sourced findings, not persuasive prose
read-link for non-social pages — yt-dlp is overkill for a plain article

domains.name: marketing-content
domains.rule: Content/social/personal output in Arabic first; code/infra in English. AR+EN bilingual layout rules apply.
never: frontend-design, premium-design-laws — a copy task does not trigger the colors+fonts deck gate
templates: od-tpl-social-*, card-* — post layout examples, read-only

domains.name: presentation
domains.rule: Premium-design-laws token sets apply to slides too. No default-font slop.
never: frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max — slides are fixed-canvas; responsive-web rules produce broken decks
templates: od-tpl-html-ppt-*, deck-* — slide templates, read-only examples

domains.name: saas-fullstack
domains.rule: Auth before Stripe. Pick a stack from the 30-sec decision tree in reference_auth_implementation; don't improvise a fifth option.
never: stripe-sdk BEFORE auth-implementation — hard order, auth ships first
saas-scaffolder on an existing codebase — it scaffolds greenfield only

domains.name: skill-management
domains.rule: Sandbox clone, audit, diff vs keep-list, graduate only gaps. Auto-resolve dup names, mirror to vmi, don't ask. Pruning needs confirmation.
never: skill-swarm — do not fan out mid-audit; audit is sequential and gated

domains.name: figma
domains.rule: MANDATORY load order: premium-design-laws → figma-immersive-premium (the router) → then the job skill. To AUTHOR motion/animation IN Figma: figma-use + figma-use-motion together (needs the metronome_plugin_api feature flag — bail fast if absent). To turn Figma motion INTO code: figma-motion-pipeline routes it (site → figma-implement-motion; app/Expo → react-native-motion). Deck-first, default-fonts ban, cinematic not flat cards, symbol hygiene. WebP fills come in blank → convert to PNG before upload_assets.
never: frontend-design — writes code, not Figma nodes; wrong direction for an authoring job
figma-implement-motion while AUTHORING — that skill is the Figma-to-code direction

domains.name: motion-render
domains.rule: GLB/Draco in Remotion needs --gl=angle + pre-decoded assets. Reuse the hyperframes-aist design system.
never: gsap* — DOM timeline model, incompatible with Remotion's frame-indexed rendering
ai-video-director — generative video, a different pipeline

domains.name: strategy-business
domains.rule: Thesis filter: boring niche + big audience + emotion/women-buyer/recurring. Rank against the $10k thesis before recommending.
never: frontend-design, coding skills — strategy output is a decision memo, not a build

domains.name: vmi-infra
domains.rule: 'The agent' is ambiguous on vmi — read the agent map BEFORE editing. Hermes prompts are Markdown jobs, NOT Claude/XML prompts.
never: Claude/XML prompt formats for Hermes — Hermes jobs are Markdown files
agents-automation fleet-spawning skills — converge on existing fleets, read the agent map first

domains.name: social-media-url
domains.rule: Invoke read-link BEFORE answering. Full 4-phase Deep Dive (who → transcript → business model → actionable for Karim + revenue estimate). Analysis is the deliverable, not extraction.
never: firecrawl, WebFetch — social platforms serve login walls and JS shells to non-browser clients

domains.name: 3d-webgl
domains.rule: Dark-luxury cinematic bar. Performance budget: 60fps on mid hardware, lazy-load heavy assets, reduced-motion fallback. Draco-compress GLBs. Object image on a site build -> img2threejs (code-only procedural model) BEFORE GLB downloads or hand-modeling; its fidelity-stop is a valid outcome.
never: react-native-*, expo-* — no DOM WebGL canvas in RN
spline-3d unless Karim names Spline — hosted scene, not the code-only default
templates: webgl-effect-recipes, immersive-web-token-vault — recipe and token sources, read-only

domains.name: image-gen
domains.rule: Nano Banana Pro default; GPT Image 2 for Arabic text-in-image. Director-grade prompts (subject/lighting/lens/mood), never one-liners. rembg for cutouts.
never: frontend-design — image generation is not a page build
arabic-ai-lettering for shipping real Arabic text — composite verified text instead

domains.name: audio-voice
domains.rule: Use Karim's 10 custom ElevenLabs voices (4 EN / 4 AR / 2 SO) by voice_id from the reference — never generic stock voices for his brands. For AI phone receptionists use Bland library voices via the bland-ai-receptionist skill (ElevenLabs rule is for content voiceovers, not phone agents); Arabic on Bland is unverified — test before selling.
never: bland-ai-receptionist for content voiceover — phone agents only
ElevenLabs custom voices for phone agents — use Bland library voices there

domains.name: docs-files
domains.rule: Premium-design-laws typography applies to documents too. Contracts/NDAs get contract-review pass before sending.
never: frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max, canvas-ui — documents are not web pages; web layout rules corrupt them

domains.name: security
domains.rule: Authorized targets only (own infra: vmi, local, own repos). Findings ranked by severity with reproduction steps. Never commit secrets; check .env exposure first.
never: red-team against third-party targets — authorized infra only (vmi, local, Karim's own repos)

domains.name: agents-automation
domains.rule: Read the architecture roadmap BEFORE adding a new agent system — converge on existing fleets, don't spawn a 7th. Batch 2-3 agents/round. Backups in _backups/, not /tmp.
never: spawning a new fleet before reading reference_vmi_agent_map.md — converge, do not add a 7th system

domains.name: data-analytics
domains.rule: Load the dataviz skill before ANY chart code. Verification Lock: numbers come from the actual data, never estimated. State sample size and caveats.
never: frontend-design, premium-design-laws — chart color comes from the dataviz palette, not the web deck

domains.name: planning-spec
domains.rule: Brainstorm before plan, plan before code. Every phase ends with a verify-checkpoint. Lock scope with Karim before building — don't infer full redesigns.
never: implementation skills (focused-fix, frontend-design, saas-scaffolder) — the plan phase produces a plan, not code

domains.name: arabic-type
domains.rule: Separate the three layers: calligraphic tradition (Naskh/Thuluth/Diwani) vs font family (Amiri/Reem Kufi) vs composition preset (seal/vertical/ink). Never call a preset a font. Verify any Google Fonts family name with arabic-typography/scripts/verify_families.py before recommending it. Clear the licence BEFORE download — server-side rendering of user text needs OFL or an explicit SaaS licence. Never ship AI-generated Arabic that no one has read back; composite real text instead. Authentic Thuluth/Diwani usually needs a calligrapher, not a free font.
never: google-fonts-* without running verify_families.py — family names are routinely hallucinated
arabic-ai-lettering for shipped copy — AI Arabic glyphs must never ship unread

domains.name: project-blueprint
keywords: what do i need to build
domains.rule: Scaffold with planmap/scripts/planmap_scaffold.py (it reuses topic_workspace.py — never reimplement the folder set). Lock scope with ONE either/or question and STOP before mapping. Every route and every integration gets a row; a gap says 'TBD — needs decision', never silence. Cost figures carry their tokens-per-call assumption. MANUAL-SETUP.md opens with real counts of accounts, keys, blocking steps and waiting days — underselling Apple/Stripe/DUNS paperwork is the failure mode.
never: coding and build skills — the blueprint stops at the map; building is a separate approved job
